title: SCH-CNT-002 utility definition
description: A utility definition. The project-owned typed validator in src/MechaMiner.Content/Categories/ remains authoritative; this schema is the draft 2020-12 mirror kept for editor and tool interoperability, and a fixture corpus proves the two reach the same accept/reject verdict on every structural case. See content/schemas/README.md. Ranks are integers with zero meaning Installed: the authored strings were display text and were ordinal, so they sort and validate as integers. The catalog_wide_rules block is not declared - fourteen sentences byte-identical across all thirteen utilities is a catalog rule, not per-utility data.

id.title: A stable, case-sensitive ASCII content ID

material_id.description: The material this utility is assigned to. Absent exactly when ore_only_exception is true: doc 40 names the two as alternatives.

ore_only_exception.description: Whether this is the ore-only radar exception. One boolean gates nine fields that were previously nine nulls each saying the same thing.

behavior_kind.description: The registered behavior. A lower-kebab-case token. Whether it resolves to exactly one registered behavior descriptor is the behavior registry's check and is deliberately not asserted here.

effect_kind.description: How the rank values combine with the statistics they name. The closest thing to a registered kind anywhere in the authored tree.

affected_stat_names.description: The named statistics this utility modifies.

items.description: A statistic from the shared vocabulary every trait, utility, PowerUp and relic modifies.

stacking_classification.description: How this utility's value combines with others naming the same statistic.

stored_charges.description: How many charges a recharging utility holds. Hoisted to the definition because it was constant across every rank row of the one utility that has it.

minimum.derivation: the section makes integer currency and rank values integral in source; a count of things that exist begins at one, because a count of zero is the absence of the field rather than a value of it

ranks.description: The rank rows, starting at rank zero for Installed. A uniform rank-and-value pair replaces thirteen differently-named payload keys; the unit comes from effect_kind and the statistic from affected_stat_names, so nothing is lost.

rank.description: The rank, where zero means Installed.

minimum.derivation: the section makes counts integral; this one is summed into a report column across the catalog, so zero is authored rather than omitted and the floor is zero rather than one
the section states that durations are nonnegative and that rates cannot be negative, so the floor of every duration and rate is zero and there is no upper bound the section supplies

rank_count.description: How many ranks above Installed. The rank array's length is checked against this plus one.

minimum.derivation: the section makes counts integral; this one is summed into a report column across the catalog, so zero is authored rather than omitted and the floor is zero rather than one

rank_ore_costs.description: One price per rank above Installed.

minimum.derivation: the section makes integer currency and rank values integral in source; a count of things that exist begins at one, because a count of zero is the absence of the field rather than a value of it

material_unit_cost.description: The fabrication cost in material units.

minimum.derivation: the section makes integer currency and rank values integral in source; a count of things that exist begins at one, because a count of zero is the absence of the field rather than a value of it

common_ore_cost.description: The fabrication cost in common ore, on the ore-only radar alone.

minimum.derivation: the section makes integer currency and rank values integral in source; a count of things that exist begins at one, because a count of zero is the absence of the field rather than a value of it

utility_slots_filled.description: How many loadout slots this utility occupies.

minimum.derivation: the section makes integer currency and rank values integral in source; a count of things that exist begins at one, because a count of zero is the absence of the field rather than a value of it

unique_in_loadout.description: Whether only one copy may be installed.

dismantlable.description: Whether an installed utility can be dismantled.

replaceable.description: Whether an installed utility can be replaced.

sellable.description: Whether an installed utility can be sold.

refundable_during_run.description: Whether a purchase can be refunded mid-run.

previews_all_four_effect_tiers.description: Whether the fabrication screen previews every tier.

rank_values_are_totals_not_cumulative_ad.description: Whether a rank's value is the total or an addition.

pool_availability.description: Which pool this utility comes from.

unlock_id.description: The unlock that grants it. Present exactly when the pool token says the utility is behind one; the unlock's cost and name are the unlock's own fields and a copy here would be a second writer on them.

always_present_in_fixed_fabrication_cata.description: Whether the utility is always in the fabrication catalog.

tracking.title: What a utility tracks
tracking.description: The tracked category count is not declared: it is the length of tracked_categories.

provides_direction_only.description: Whether only a bearing is shown.

provides_exact_distance.description: Whether an exact distance is shown.

provides_map_marker.description: Whether a map marker is placed.

maximum_simultaneous_bearings.description: How many bearings may show at once.

minimum.derivation: the section makes integer currency and rank values integral in source; a count of things that exist begins at one, because a count of zero is the absence of the field rather than a value of it

bearing_fan_threshold_degrees.description: How close two bearings must be before they fan.

minimum.derivation: the section names _degrees as a unit suffix; the smallest angular threshold is no separation at all, which is zero degrees

maximum.derivation: the section names _degrees as a unit suffix; the largest angular separation two bearings can have is a full turn, which is three hundred and sixty degrees

bearing_cluster_collapse_above_count.description: How many bearings collapse into a cluster.

minimum.derivation: the section makes integer currency and rank values integral in source; a count of things that exist begins at one, because a count of zero is the absence of the field rather than a value of it

version.title: A positive integer version
version.description: The initial schema_version and content_version of every first-authored definition is 1.

minimum.derivation: the initial value of every first-authored definition is 1 and both versions only ever increment, so no valid version is below 1; there is no upper bound because a definition may be revised without limit

name_key.title: Localization key for the player-facing name

summary_key.title: Localization key for the concise player-facing summary

tags.title: Closed query and tooling vocabulary
tags.description: The vocabulary starts empty, so [] is the only accepted value.

presentation_id.title: Logical presentation entry
presentation_id.description: Omitted when a definition never appears in-world. No accepted document mints a grammar for a presentation ID, and inventing one for a category with zero members would be structure ahead of need, so the only constraint is that an authored value is not the empty string.

minLength.rationale: not a capacity bound: the empty string is what the compiler materializes for an omitted field, so an authored empty string would be a second way to say 'absent'. 1 is the smallest length that excludes it

allOf.title: the ore-only exception gates nine fields at once
allOf.description: One boolean decides whether a utility is assigned to a material or is the ore-only radar. Nine fields follow from it, which is why it is a discriminator and not nine nullable fields.

allOf.title: an unlock reference follows the pool token
